title: Test suite: core CRUD and infrastructure tests
description: Create .claude/skills/agent-memory/tests/__init__.py (empty) and the skeleton of .claude/skills/agent-memory/tests/test_memory.py. Follow the _TempDirTest base-class pattern from skill-spec-management/tests/test_spec.py: each test chdir's into a fresh tempfile.mkdtemp(). Override DB path via AGENT_MEMORY_DB env var pointing to a temp file. Mock _embed() to return a deterministic random unit vector of shape (N, 384) for all tests by default, with an integration test class guarded by AGENT_MEMORY_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1. Implement test classes: TestInit (idempotent init, tables exist), TestAdd (returns ID, row in both tables, auto-init), TestSearch (most similar text returned, --limit, --json output), TestDelete (removes from both tables, unknown ID exits 1), TestList (newest-first, --source filter, --limit 0 returns all), TestStats (populated DB, missing DB exits 0).
acceptance_criteria: _TempDirTest base class used; each test method chdir's into fresh temp dir
AGENT_MEMORY_DB env var used to redirect DB path in all tests
_embed is mocked to return deterministic (N, 384) unit vector
TestInit: init is idempotent and tables exist after init
TestAdd: add returns an ID and row is present in both tables
TestSearch: returns most similar text, respects --limit, --json output is valid JSON
TestDelete: removes from both tables; unknown ID exits 1
TestList: newest-first order, --source filter works, --limit 0 returns all
TestStats: works on populated DB; exits 0 on missing DB
